result.description: A fictional low-power memory module designed for compact embedded systems and ultraportable devices. The Meridian series emphasizes bandwidth efficiency, modest heat output, and a balanced power profile for always-on appliances and thin client workstations. It uses LPDDR5X signaling in a soldered-module style package intended for OEM integration rather than retail upgrades.
